instruction: Use command-line automation only to operate the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment through the CAMWorks API; do not use GUI clicks, GUI automation, generic G-code generators, prebuilt helper wrappers, or manual .nc editing/copying. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\job_input.step and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\tools.csv. Create a native CAM part from the STEP model. Use G54 with the model top-face center at model coordinates [0, 0, 18] mm and tool axis -Z, so the posted model top is Z=0. Create exactly three machining operations using only the listed tools, once each: T1, a 10 mm flat end mill at S7500 rpm and F520 mm/min, for one Pocket operation that clears the central 44 x 28 mm pocket to Z=-11 mm; T2, a 5 mm drill at S5000 rpm and F180 mm/min, for one Drill operation that machines the four through holes centered at (X,Y)=(-35,-20), (-35,20), (35,-20), and (35,20) mm through the 18 mm part, allowing the installed CAM system's bounded drill-tip or breakthrough allowance below Z=-18 mm; and T3, a 6 mm profile end mill at S9000 rpm and F650 mm/min, for one Profile/Contour/Contour Mill operation that cuts the complete 120 x 80 mm outside perimeter to Z=-18 mm with correct cutter-radius compensation. Generate the native operation plan and toolpaths, run native SOLIDWORKS CAM simulation/verification for all three operations with no gouges or undercuts, and post-process with the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM postprocessor. Save the posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-06.nc.
